prompt: A POSIX queue holds two messages at priority 3 and one at priority 7. Which message does a successful mq_receive return first?

options.explanation: FIFO order breaks ties within one priority; it does not override the higher available priority.
POSIX queues select the oldest message at the highest available priority.
Message queues preserve discrete message boundaries; one receive returns one message.
Message size does not determine priority order.

workedExample: First identify the highest available priority: 7. There is one message at that priority, so it is selected. Once it is removed, the two priority-3 messages are received in arrival order, assuming no new higher-priority messages arrive.
